# External Publication Checklist

**Status:** ratified control under D-P8 and D-P11 · **Date:** 2026-07-26

Material may be externally used only when every applicable item is satisfied and documented:

- [ ] Each material claim has an eligible source or ratified decision and precise provenance.
- [ ] Evidence classification permits the proposed wording.
- [ ] Contradictions are resolved or specifically disclosed.
- [ ] Missing-source dependencies are disclosed.
- [ ] Partner organizations are described using their documented status; otherwise `prospective` or `potential`.
- [ ] The current negative feasibility finding is not omitted, minimized, or contradicted.
- [ ] Scenarios and planning strategies are not presented as adopted design or verified fact.
- [ ] Property status states that the sponsor does not currently own the property.
- [ ] Address usage follows D-P12; source-specific addresses remain unchanged where required.
- [ ] Illustrative renderings and planning-level estimates are labeled at point of use.
- [ ] Independent audit and correction gates are complete.

## Prohibited without new evidence and approval

Do not state or imply:

- ownership, site control, contract, or acquisition;
- executed partner commitments or hospital endorsement;
- City approval or entitlement approval;
- confirmed FPL or utility capacity;
- finalized building height or adopted 6-/8-story design;
- secured grants, subsidies, TIF, bonds, QOZ benefits, or tax credits;
- validated $50/RSF rent or any unresolved rent basis;
- AV revenue in a governance-clean base case;
- institutional feasibility or guaranteed returns;
- finalized construction pricing.

**Publication decision:** `blocked` unless all gates are affirmatively documented.
